pick.headline: Armed militants seize the Grand Mosque in Mecca
pick.summary: On November 20, 1979, several hundred armed militants led by Juhayman al-Otaybi seized the Grand Mosque in Mecca. Saudi forces retook it after two weeks of fighting.
pick.significance: False rumors of US involvement led mobs to attack the US Embassy in Islamabad the next day. The siege pushed the Saudi monarchy toward stricter religious policies.
pick.fbis: The Middle East & North Africa report of November 21, 1979, listed Saudi coverage of the seizure of the Haram mosque: an Interior Ministry statement and Riyadh's assurance that the situation was under control.
